description: record_<env> deletes a decommissioned app's landing-zone record only once its service connection is recorded gone (sandbox run 3421, ADR-0056 amendment 2026-11-12); without that check the record could go while a connection is left.

patches.find:
if [ "$(jq -r --arg k "connection-$env_name" '.detail[$k] // ""' "$(prov_status_path "$SAF_IN/ado" "$slug")" 2> /dev/null)" != gone ]; then
    saf_info "  $slug in $env_name: its service connection isn't deleted yet; the record $lz_name stays (the next run deletes the connection, then the record)"
    return 0
  fi
